status: unqualified source/component checkpoint; startup and packaging remain disabled
implemented: One bound publication owner per selected executor; publication service is independent of mailbox reads and creates no connections.
Protocol receives the initial fast turn, then ready DATA/protocol ledgers alternate under independent quota authority.
Permission exhaustion waits for a real state-change notification without nonce/spend churn; protocol service can continue while DATA is exhausted.
At most one exact prepared body is retained per worker; unstarted service can resume, uncertain publication cannot blindly re-APPEND and stays charged.
Physical preparation/publication timing and accepted MIME bytes are separated from useful-delivery/RTT learning.
Verified BODY records apply in one bounded session turn; standalone credits coalesce beyond initial light demand and remain immediate at the peer edge.
Cold TLS/HTTP through IMAP now runs four independent publication workers plus a fixture read pump on the same four physical sockets.
retained_failure: The initial 5-repeat cohort had one cold-application fixture failure after it exceeded the existing 64-message mailbox bound. Independent publication exposed credit feedback on small reads and inter-record feedback publication. The bound, original OPEN/TLS/header limits, BODY sizes, grant/account quotas and timed qualification gates were not raised. Corrected credit/body feedback passed the same cohort and bounds.
validation: FETCH completes before a withheld APPEND tag; worker cancellation leaves the carrier selected for NOOP.
A new independently issued grant wakes parked DATA without rewriting old used/pending wallet exposure.
Lost reply produces one retained exact body, one spend and no automatic re-APPEND.
A credit control can proceed after DATA permission exhaustion without borrowing the DATA ledger.
128 small application reads produce one coalesced credit; a peer at its credit edge receives immediate newly backed credit.
limits: No adaptive multi-account carrier scheduler, service calibration, receiver-window integration, roster/bootstrap grant exchange or complete recovery/reclamation yet.
The pipeline still has pre-established Noise/grants and one in-process account; it is not the 10/15-account, independent-process or Android TUN qualification.
No proven sustained 100Mbps or required idle/loaded RTT; no deployable package.
